note: Fixed menu anchor-link scrolling in responsive-header-system.js: the in-page navigation handler used window.scrollTo(), which is unreliable on this page (html has scroll-behavior:smooth from CSS and window.scrollTo({behavior:'auto'}) does not reliably override it in all environments). Switched alignTarget() to set documentElement/body.scrollTop directly (temporarily forcing scroll-behavior:auto), which reliably lands on the target section after the mobile/desktop menu closes. Verified live: clicking Gallery/Exhibitions/etc. in the menu now scrolls to the correct section instead of leaving the viewport at the top.
